scope:
First-live tests after the live key was activated on 2026-10-20: T5 (live half), T9 and T10, plus a T0 observation without a receipt. Yu ran the T5 full run and every T9 run at Yu's own terminal; the first T5 attempt and the T10 reads ran from the agent's shell (see run_by). Raw responses stay private under STATE_ROOT/profiles/

/live-tests/; this file holds test ids, receipt digests, CLI commands without ids, codes, field names, booleans, counts, durations and short notes only; clock times are left out (run_date gives the day; the T10 CLOSED-retention poll ran on into 2026-10-22). Codes not in a receipt come from the live journal, opened read-only and immutable, with only event kinds, states, outcome codes, counts and monotonic durations taken, and from the session notes.
receipt_sha256_convention: sha256 of the SHA256SUMS file in the private receipt directory, as on 2026-10-13. One T5 entry is the 2026-10-13 T8a receipt (listed as T8 in betfair-live-tests-2026-10-13.json): Yu decided it counts as the receipt for T5's delayed half, so it is listed here as T5 too; it was not re-run. The first T5 attempt stopped before any live-key call and is recorded under live_test_observations.T5 only. The first T9 attempt was refused before any send and has no receipt directory.

key_types.T10: delayed, except the 0-minute read, which is T9 probe 1's own live-key read

live_half.command: python3 <archive>/live-1/livekey-check.py (a read-only helper outside the repository, using the repository's ReadClient; not a CLI command)
live_half.catalogue_filter: event type 7, GB and IE, WIN, rest of the day
live_half.also_holds: one live-key cert login, which the receipt README calls the T1 live-key check; it is not listed as T1

first_attempt.run_by: the agent's shell, at Yu's request
first_attempt.note: the live-key Keychain read did not succeed from the agent's shell; the full run was then made at Yu's terminal

delayed_half.receipt: the 2026-10-13 T8a receipt, recorded as T8 in betfair-live-tests-2026-10-13.json
delayed_half.counted_as_T5_by: Yu's decision, relayed on 2026-10-21 and confirmed by Yu directly on 2026-10-22: T8a counts as the receipt for T5's delayed half, and this report says so

T5.both_halves: REST market books carried is_market_data_delayed true on the delayed key (T8a, 2 markets, 2 reads each) and false on the live key (1 market, 1 read)

T9.arming: armed with the archive helper arm-live.py and disarmed with disarm-live.py after each probe; live-probe needs every arming condition except A19 and a typed confirmation at a terminal

attempts.selection: a non-runner taken from the catalogue
attempts.lesson: the catalogue lists non-runners; pick an ACTIVE runner from the book

attempts.finding: a fully cancelled, never-matched bet was gone from listCurrentOrders at once and was not in listClearedOrders before settlement, so a lookup after the cancel could not verify the ref

attempts.change: PR #30: look the bet up by ref before the cancel, with the cancel in a finally
attempts.merge: rebase merge after two Astra reviews (accept with nits) and Yu's go-ahead

attempts.after: no open position, not halted, disarmed
attempts.note: the second observation that a cancelled, unmatched bet leaves listCurrentOrders at once

T9.customer_ref_echo: not_answered: neither receipt keeps the raw place report, and the normalised report keeps only the instruction-level customer_order_ref

T10.run_by: the 0-minute read is T9 probe 1's own read, part of Yu's terminal run; the 2-minute and 15-minute reads, the post-settle read and the retention poll ran from the agent's shell (session notes)
T10.key_type: mixed: the 0-minute read is the probe's own read on the live-order session (live key, at 416702f), reused T9 evidence; every later T10 read used the delayed key
T10.order_reads_command: unknown: the README names the API methods, not the command
T10.ids_omitted_from_receipt: betId and customerOrderRef values were compared with the journal in memory and not stored; the private receipt does keep market and selection identifiers and the customerStrategyRef

closed_retention.command: book --market <probe market> --price-data EX_BEST_OFFERS (other flags not recorded)
closed_retention.basis: one market on one day; a lower bound, not a retention period

T10.settled_bet_leaves_listCurrentOrders: not_answered: the probe was cancelled unmatched and was already gone before settlement
T10.sha256sums_note: SHA256SUMS was rewritten on 2026-10-22, after the poll ended, to cover the two retention files; an earlier digest beginning 1a5f0cd7edcd in the session notes is superseded

T0.source: Yu's account in the session notes, plus the T5 first-attempt receipt
T0.app_key_live_created_with_empty_trust_li: unknown: keychain_setup_commands prints the live key's add command with -T "", but how the item was created is not in these sources
T0.follow_up: Yu removes /usr/bin/security from the app-key.live item's Always Allow list by hand, then checks that the prompt returns on the next live-key read (Yu's decision, confirmed 2026-10-22)

not_run.T0: observation only, no receipt; see live_test_observations.T0
not_run.T1: the T5 live-half receipt holds a live-key cert login (SUCCESS, can_bet true), not listed as T1; the T1 receipt stays the 2026-10-13 delayed-key one
not_run.T2: not run on 2026-10-21; run on 2026-10-22 and reported separately
not_run.T3: not run on 2026-10-21; run on 2026-10-22 and reported separately
not_run.T4: not re-run with the live key
not_run.T6: live-key half deferred by Yu's decision (confirmed 2026-10-22): run it only if the rollout design still needs it
not_run.T7: not re-run with the live key
not_run.T8: not re-run with the live key

facts_not_relabelled.F22: neither T9 receipt keeps the raw place report; Yu decided (confirmed 2026-10-22) that F22 is captured from the raw place report in PT1 and PT4, with no extra probe
facts_not_relabelled.F47: the T5 live half shows a funded live key returning is_market_data_delayed false; no unfunded or overridden live key was tried
facts_not_relabelled.F73: no T0 receipt; Yu's account of one dialog, then Always Allow, then no dialog is in live_test_observations.T0

findings_for_next_register_round.F43: candidate for a secondary first_person_observation on the isMarketDataDelayed part: the two T5 receipts show it present, true on the delayed key and false on the live key; the snapshot is normalised, so the rest of the value is not shown; the register is not edited in this report
findings_for_next_register_round.F36: candidate on the cancelled-bet part: the T10 receipt shows the cancelled, unmatched probe absent from cleared CANCELLED in 3 reads before settlement and present after it; lapsed bets were not tested, and F36's secondary slot already holds forum_participant_opinion
findings_for_next_register_round.F77: candidate on the CLOSED part only: the settled market read CLOSED in 72 of 72 polls over about 23.7 h (one market, a lower bound); the listCurrentOrders part is not answered
findings_for_next_register_round.F23: probe 2 found its bet by filtering listCurrentOrders on customerOrderRef (1 row), which supports 'can be filtered on'; F23 is in no checklist row, so it is not relabelled
findings_for_next_register_round.cancelled_unmatched: in both probes a fully cancelled, never-matched bet was gone from listCurrentOrders (by ref, orderProjection ALL) right after the cancel; no fact in the register states this, and the probe now looks the bet up before the cancel (PR #30)

limitations: Two live orders, both the fixed probe, both cancelled with nothing matched; no strategy order and no open position.
Each observation is one run on one account on one day; it shows behaviour seen, not a documented guarantee.
The CLOSED period is a lower bound from one market: the poll stopped at its 72-poll limit, not on a miss.
The T0 notes are Yu's account relayed in the session, not a receipt.

The probe and T10 SHA256SUMS files were written on 2026-10-22, after the T10 poll ended; the probe files match the per-file hashes the probe journaled when it ran, while the T10 files have no run-time hash.
The refused T9 attempt has no receipt; its codes come from the live journal only.
Raw responses, the journal and order rows stay private; no market or selection id, betId, ref or account value is here.
